KaTeX 0.19.0 font redistribution notice

These unmodified TTF, WOFF, and WOFF2 files were obtained from the official
KaTeX npm distribution:
https://registry.npmjs.org/katex/-/katex-0.19.0.tgz
Upstream project: https://github.com/KaTeX/KaTeX/tree/v0.19.0

The JavaScript and CSS package's MIT license at ../LICENSE does not replace
the separate font license. The bundled font files identify SIL Open Font
License, Version 1.1 in their embedded metadata. See the complete OFL.txt in
this directory. The OFL does not require documents produced using these
fonts to be licensed under the OFL.
